name: SGLang
notable_features: RadixAttention: a radix tree over the KV cache so any shared prefix, not just an exact-prefix match, is reused
SGLang language primitives (radix cache, jump-forward decoding, LPM cache-aware admission) are exposed as first-class knobs
Strong RL-rollout story: the same engine is used to generate training rollouts, and SGLang Diffusion adds image/video generation in the same package
OpenAI-compatible server, a Rust component in the tree, and sgl-router for multi-model routing
Separate backends for TPU (SGL-JAX and SGL-torchtpu) alongside the main PyTorch path
hardware_caveats: CUDA 13 is required: the CUDA 12.9 wheel/image lane is retired because PyTorch 2.14 publishes no CUDA 12.9 builds, and SGLang 0.5.19 is the last release with a CUDA 12 lane

FlashInfer is the default attention backend and only supports sm75 and above; on sm75+ devices with FlashInfer problems the documented fallback is --attention-backend triton --sampling-backend pytorch
Many dependencies publish pre-release wheels only, so uv installs silently land on an old version (0.5.9) unless --prerelease=allow is passed

The documented supported-hardware list is narrower than vLLM's: NVIDIA A100/H100/H200/H800/H20/B200/B300/GB200/GB300 plus select RTX 30/40/50, and AMD MI300X/MI325X/MI350X/MI355X. No consumer AMD Radeon entry
TPU support is split across sibling projects (SGL-JAX, SGL-torchtpu), so TPU parity with the main CUDA path is not automatic
Apple Silicon and Intel support exist but are documented on separate hardware-platform pages with far less detail than the NVIDIA path
best_for: Agentic and RL workloads where many requests share long, branching context - the radix cache reuses partial prefixes, not just exact ones
Serving latency-sensitive multi-turn conversation, because prefix reuse removes the re-prefill of chat history
Teams that want to experiment with scheduling policy rather than just tune it
avoid_for: Environments pinned to CUDA 12 - there is no supported lane any more
Installs where a silently downgraded dependency is acceptable risk; the pre-release dependency set is a real operational hazard
Consumer AMD Radeon cards, which are not in the documented support list
notes: Scheduling terms: 'radix-cache' is the distinguishing mechanism (radix tree over KV blocks); 'prefix-cache' is used here in the looser sense that the radix cache provides prefix reuse generally. AMD entry is Instinct-class only per the README's supported-hardware table. TPU and NPU paths are separate projects, so 'tpu' here means supported but not first-class in this repo.
